findings.reason: the node-wide occupancy the decision turns on is invisible to the named source, so an implementer following the plan builds the wrong probe and the `auto` branch fails in exactly the case §document says is current.
findings.text: §2 says the live ledger "takes each job's cards and node from `_running_jobs`, which already returns them" and `auto` takes the overlap path only when "the ledger has room for a second copy of the serve's cards, cores and memory", but `_running_jobs` (cli.py:1219) queries `squeue -u $USER` unless explicit ids are passed, so it returns only the operator's own jobs; §document's own evidence for why the overlap path is unavailable is that "two embedding jobs of **another user** held 2", and another user's cards are the quantity `auto` must read to decide there is no room — so the ledger as specified would report room that does not exist and dispatch overlap into a 15-minute readiness wait instead of choosing the paused cycle.
